description: A paid round-trip check: returns pong and the server time. Use to test that an x402 wallet, client or MCP setup can pay and receive a result. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

only.description: Optional: comma-separated top-level result keys to keep, for a smaller answer (for example only=price,symbol); unknown keys are ignored and an empty match returns the full result
